snippet.title: Vaultbreakers Alpha Test Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

The Dragonvault has awakened, and it's time to break in. Vaultbreakers is a top-down extraction action RPG from BetaDwarf, the studio behind Minion Masters. Drop into a vast, corrupted fantasy world solo or with friends, battle through brutal enemies and bosses, grab ancient artifacts, and make it out alive with your loot. Gear up your Vaultbreaker, unlock perks, find powerful build synergies, and switch freely between PvE and PvPvE runs, all on one shared progression.
